column3: Set the pace from the start - driven out approaching 2f out - kept finding more to the line without a serious threat in sight
Tracked the pace - found extra room 3f out - into second inside final 2f under a drive - kept going but couldn't threaten the winner
Held up at the back - made ground on the inside approaching the final 4f and pressed for third over 2f out - stayed on same gear to finish third
Settled at the back early - asked for effort with over 2f left - kept going without threatening the front - finished 4th
Held up handy in the pack - urged forward with over two furlongs left - lost ground two out - eventually finished fifth
Sat close to front group early - urged forward with over 2f remaining - lost touch and faded into finish
Settled off the front group early - moved through to hit the front 3f out - asked for effort 2f out and edged away to score
Set the early tempo - lost front spot after 4f and settled second - pressed for effort with 2f left - held on steadily through final furlong to finish runner-up
Settled midpack early - pushed along to close on the front group over 2f out - stayed on same gear from the final furlong to finish third
Settled towards the back - made progress 2f out - pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on but never a threat to the front pair
Settled off the pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to find more from 1f out - finished fifth
Settled towards the back - pressed into effort 2f out - stayed on same gear but couldn't reach front-runners
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on late without threatening the front runners
Settled behind the front group pulling hard - hit the front after 4f - lost command 3f out - pressed but faded 2f out to finish well held
Settled in the pack - pushed along and dropped away 2f out - finished 9th
Sluggish start - stayed at the back of the field throughout - well held by the finish
Positioned behind the front group early - pushed along and dropped away fast with 2f left - well held at the finish
Settled around midpack - pressed for effort before fading inside final 2f - eventually well held in 12th
Held up in the pack - urged forward around halfway - dropped away with 3f left - well beaten at the finish
Dwelt and stayed behind the field early - not far off the pace by halfway - improved position from 3f out - moved into second before 2f left then edged ahead close home to score

Held a forward spot early - hit the front at halfway - urged on with over 2f left - driven out inside the final furlong - kept responding but overtaken close home - couldn't find more in the closing yards to finish second
Settled in the pack - driven up to make ground approaching final 3f - stayed on inside final furlong but lacked the speed to get closer - finished third beaten a length
Held up early - made progress into contention 4f out - up to third 3f out under pressure - stayed on well late to finish fourth
Set the pace early - overtaken and settled just off the front after 2f - dropped away 5f out - driven on with 4f left before fading in the final furlong to finish 5th
Settled midfield early - moved into contention through halfway and up to second by 5f out - driven from over 2f out - lost ground steadily to finish sixth
Slow to break - sat in touch with the front group - driven approaching the 3f marker then dropped away quickly

Pushed on early to take command after 2 furlongs - overtaken and sat just behind at halfway before slipping back and driven on approaching the 4-furlong marker - faded steadily from 3 out to finish well beaten in 8th
Settled midfield early - pushed along and hit front inside final furlong - kept going well to win
Set the pace early - pressed for effort 2f out and lost command with a furlong left - battled on bravely to the line for second
Sat close to front group early - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same speed through final furlong to finish third
Settled at the back - pushed along 2f out and kept on from inside the final furlong - finished fourth but unable to close further
Settled towards the back - pushed along over 2f out - stayed on same rate late without reaching front rank
Sluggish start - settled towards back - pushed along 2f out but couldn't close on front pack
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away in the final furlong to finish seventh
Tracked pace-setter early - pressed for effort then dropped away inside final 2f - well held at finish
Up with the pack early - moved into second and hit the front over 2f out - driven out from 1f out and forged decisively inside the final furlong

Slow into stride and settled at back - driven up into contention from 2f out - drifted left but stayed on under pressure inside final furlong - moved into second close home - unable to challenge winner - finished second
Quick out of the gate to hit the front - driven forward with over 2f left - overtaken soon after - kept up the effort to the line for third
Held a midfield spot early - roused with 2f left then improved to press the front-runner inside final furlong - lost momentum turning for the final 110yds
Settled midfield - urged into effort with over 2f left - stayed the pace before fading in the closing furlong - finished fifth
Settled off the pace on own path away from rivals - urged forward before 3f out and dropped away - beaten some way back at the finish
Handy in the early stages - driven to keep tempo over 2f out - eased out of contention finishing well held in 7th
Held up at the back throughout - no impression made - finished well held in 8th
Sent clear early and held advantage for three furlongs before being headed - driven back in front with a furlong remaining - kept battling to the line to score
Tracked pace for opening 3f - took a check behind front group - pushed along in pursuit of eventual winner inside final furlong - kept responding but unable to reel in rival close home
Settled towards back early - pushed along with 2f left before finding another gear late - stayed on strongly to the line finishing third
Sat close up early before hitting front after 3f - clear and travelling well by halfway - pressed for effort 2f out then overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish fourth
Settled around midfield - pushed along with 2f left and closed strongly with a furlong to run - couldn't find more late and held for 5th
Settled at the back - asked for effort with 4f left - made no impression - finished sixth
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished seventh
Settled towards the back - pushed along and lost touch two out - well beaten at the finish
Went straight to the front - driven and lost the advantage just inside 2f out - shaken up over 1f out and drifted right - rallied to regain command with a furlong left and stayed on to win

Settled up with pace - shaken up to edge in front approaching 2f out - urged clear inside final 2f - eased right in the closing stages before being overtaken close home - unable to find more and beaten a length into second
Slow to break - settled midfield - made headway approaching 3f out - into fourth and driven 2f out then flattened out final furlong
Settled midfield early - asked for effort with 3f remaining - stayed on but never reached front rank - finished fourth beaten 5.75L
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort with 3f left - unable to reach the front two - finished 5th beaten well
Handy in the pack early - moved into third with 3f left - driven approaching the final furlong and dropped away - finished sixth
Sat close to the front pair early - driven and lost ground over 2f out - soon toiling in rear
Held up in the pack - urged forward approaching halfway - unable to land a blow thereafter - well held in 8th
Slow into stride - never able to land a blow - buried at the back for the duration - well held in 9th
Knocked by another runner at the break - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f remaining - moved through from the wide outside to hit the front a furlong out and stayed on well to score

Settled midpack and racing wide - pressed for effort 2f out and made ground to reach the front group entering the final furlong - briefly looked a threat - couldn't find more in the last 110 yards - held for second
Sat close to pace early - pushed along with 2f left - hit front briefly inside final furlong before being overtaken - stayed on to finish third
Sat close to the front - pushed along with 2f left and edged left inside final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish fourth beaten 3 lengths
Settled off the front group - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on without gaining over 1f out - finished fifth
Drifted left and clipped a runner at the break - settled midfield and pushed along with 2f left - stayed on late to finish sixth beaten 4.5 lengths
Sprinted clear from the gate - moved over to the rail to command - pressed for effort with 2f left - overtaken a furlong out and faded late to finish 7th
Sluggish start - settled at back of field - never a threat - finished eighth beaten just under seven lengths
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished well held in 9th
Sluggish start - trailed near the back throughout - finished well held in 10th
Sat close to the pace early - fighting for head early on - pushed along and gave way inside final 2f - eventually held in 11th
Set the pace from the off - opened up a healthy advantage inside the final two furlongs and stretched it approaching the line - allowed to coast home in front
Settled in second early - pressed for the lead 2f out - stayed on for a clear second without troubling the winner
Sat in third early - pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on same pace to finish third
Settled at the back of the field - urged forward with 2f remaining - unable to find the speed to challenge - finished a well-held 4th
Held up in rear early - urged forward with over 2f left - no impression made on the leaders - finished well held in 5th
Soon in front near the rail - pushed along with 2f left - pulled clear from a furlong out - in charge throughout for the win
Tracked front group early - pushed along over 2f out and closed on winner inside final furlong - stayed on strongly for second
Settled at back of field - pushed along and moved left approaching final 2f - stayed on same gear from 1f out to finish third
Raced in second wide of track - pressed for effort inside final furlong - lost ground close home - finished fourth
Held up early settling in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close on the front-runners - eventually beaten well over 8 lengths in 5th
Close up early - pressed for effort and slipped to the back before halfway - driven but faded 2f out - finished sixth beaten 15 lengths
Handy in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - closed on pacesetter approaching final furlong - got up close home to win
Handy early - shaken up to hit the front 2f out - challenged inside final furlong - caught close home to finish second by a short head
Settled in the pack - slipped to the back over 2f out - pushed along and found extra to move into third with a furlong left - kept on to finish third
Set the pace early - lost the advantage but stayed in touch 3f out - pushed along 2f out and soon dropped away
Settled just off the pace early - moved into contention 3f out - pushed into third with a furlong left - couldn't hold the spot and faded to finish fifth
Settled just behind the pace - burst through to hit the front 3f out - gave up advantage 2f out and faded away
Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back - pushed along and made progress inside the final furlong - edged ahead close home to prevail
Sat close to front early - pushed along and lost touch 2f out - rallied through final furlong - closed on rival late but denied by a short margin
Settled towards the back early - pushed along and made progress inside the final furlong - closed strongly to take third close home

Went to front under pressure from rival - opened up two lengths with two furlongs left - gap narrowed approaching final furlong - drifted right and lost the lead inside final 110 yards - faded to finish fourth
Dwelt at start - settled towards back - moved right and made progress 2f out under pressure - lost place in final furlong to finish 5th
Handy with the pack early - asked for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong - finished sixth
Held mid-pack early - urged along with 2f left - dropped away soon after - finished seventh
Handy early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away quickly - eventually finished 8th
Set the pace from the off - fended off a challenger 3 out - driven out after the last and kept finding more - drifted right in the closing stages holding on for the win
Settled in the pack early - moved through field 3 out - shared third spot approaching 2 out - pressed the front-runner into the finish and stayed on for second
Settled towards the back early - improved into midfield by the 6th - urged forward to move into fourth approaching the last - driven out on the run-in without gaining ground - stayed on for third
Held a spot just off midfield early - improved to third after the 8th - up alongside the pace-setter 3 out - driven after the last then dropped away on the run-in to finish fourth
Sat handy behind pace - driven approaching final two furlongs - kept going without landing a threat to the front
Held up towards the back - driven from the final furlong - failed to feature - finished sixth
Held up early - mistimed jump at the 6th - lost touch with the pack thereafter - finished well beaten in 7th
Settled in the pack early - stumbled badly at the 2nd - pushed along from the 10th but found nothing - trailed home well beaten in 8th
Handy early - urged in the straight - lost touch 2 out - well held at finish
Held up towards the back - lost touch by 8th under a drive - well beaten before 4 out
Handy early just behind the pace - slipped back by the 7th - dropped to the back and beaten a long way from home
Made all the running from the off - clear near the far rail early on - shaken up to go clear approaching the furlong marker - soon well on top - eased through to the line under hands riding
Sat close behind the pace - pushed along with 2f left - finished strongly to snatch second on the line
Sat close to leader - pressed for effort with 2f left - kept responding late but nabbed right on the line
Tracked front group early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to quicken in closing stages - held on for 4th
Towards the far rail in a pair - pushed along 2f out and plugged on at one speed - unable to land a blow on the opposite flank
Eased at the start - raced on the far flank in a pair - pushed along 2f out before plugging on at one speed - always held by the nearside runners to finish 6th
Settled midpack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to close on front-running group - finished seventh
Settled at the back early - pushed along with a short-lived move into contention 2f out - dropped away approaching the final furlong and allowed to finish in own time - well beaten in 8th
Settled in the pack - pushed along and dropped away 2f out - finished 9th
Sent forward from the off - settled just off the pace - squeezed for space approaching 2f out - found a gap to strike in front inside the final furlong - drew away to score comfortably
Went straight to front - drifted right approaching 2f out then lost command inside final furlong - unable to close on leader late finishing second beaten a length and a half
Settled off the pace early - lost ground over 2f out - rallied inside final furlong to take third - unable to close further
Settled close to the pace on the far side - drifted off a true line over 2f out - found little space and shifted course inside the final 2f - lost momentum in the closing stages to finish fourth
Held up handy in the pack early - eased right approaching 2f out - dropped away soon after - finished well held in 5th
Tracked front group wide - improved but knocked and edged right over 2f out - lost place in the last furlong - finished sixth
Sat close up early - disputed second at halfway - pushed into command 1 1/2f out and stayed strong to the line for victory
Sat handy behind the front group - 6th at halfway - into 3rd with two out under a squeeze - 2nd and driven early in the last furlong - stayed on but couldn't get to winner near the line
Sat just off the front group early - fourth at halfway then asked for effort inside final two furlongs - stayed on same gear late to claim third near the line
Handy near the front - hit the front by halfway - driven and lost advantage with a furlong and a half left - unable to find more inside the closing stages - finished fourth beaten under five lengths
Settled in the pack early - 5th and driven approaching final two furlongs - stayed on at the same rate through the last furlong - finished 5th
Sat close to front group early - checked mildly and 8th at halfway - improved to 6th and pushed along inside final 2f before staying on same gear to finish sixth
Settled around midfield - 6th and driven for effort with 2f left - asked for more soon after but couldn't find extra inside final furlong - finished 7th
Held up towards the back of the pack - pressed for effort with no gain approaching final furlongs - stayed on at one speed but always held
Held up towards the back - improved into contention 2f out and pushed along entering the final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish ninth
Held up towards the back - driven with no response 2f out - stayed on same rate late but well held
Settled midfield - urged forward around halfway but made no headway under pressure with a furlong and a half left - stayed on same gait to finish 11th
Held up in the pack - made progress two furlongs out - flattened out inside the final furlong to finish well held
Sat close to the front group early - still 7th at halfway - pushed along but couldn't find more from 2f out and finished without response
Held up towards the back - urged forward with little response 2f out - stayed on same gait to finish well held
Held up in the pack - driven and made a bit of progress with two furlongs left - unable to threaten leaders in the closing stages - finished well beaten in 15th
Held up towards the back - failed to get involved - one paced from 2f out - well held in 16th
Held up handy early - 5th at halfway - driven with 2f left and unable to find more thereafter
Went straight to front early - driven to stay ahead but overtaken at halfway - dropped through field 2f out and could find nothing more - finished well beaten
Held up at the back - no impression made on the leading group - well held at the finish - eventually 19th
Travelled close up wide - pushed along with 2f left - moved into command inside final furlong - pulled clear to score
Set the pace from the off - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - overtaken approaching the final furlong - unable to find more and held for second
Held a middle position - pressed for effort 2f out - moved through inside the final furlong to work into third - held on without finding more
Handy early - pushed along over 2f out and unable to match the front pack - stayed on at one gear inside final furlong - edged out of third close home to finish fourth
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 3f left - moved through tired runners inside the final furlong and stayed on to the line
Held up at rear - pushed along with two furlongs left - crept closer late to overtake tired horses inside the final furlong - finished sixth
Settled towards back of field - pushed along approaching 3f out and stayed on at one level from there - crept through late to go by tired opposition inside closing furlong - finished seventh
Settled towards the back of the pack - failed to threaten the leading group - finished eighth
Held up at the back of the field - never got involved in the finish - eventually came home 9th
Held mid-pack early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped well behind inside the final furlong
Set the pace from the off - pushed on and edged further ahead a furlong out - driven out to score readily
Settled second early - pushed along to attack leader inside final furlong - stayed on well but never able to reel in clear winner
Settled in third early - nudged for effort with a furlong left - kept going late but never a threat to the front pair - finished third
Set the pace from the start - roused approaching 2f out - stayed on under urging inside final furlong - driven out to prevail
Sat close to the pace - pressed for second spot with 2f left before edging clear again - stayed on well up the final furlong but unable to trouble winner
Drifted left at the off - fighting for the bridle early - settled midpack - pushed along and went second for a moment 2f out - unable to match the front pair and beaten into third
Drifted right and clipped rivals at the break - settled last - pushed along two out then faded quickly
Drifted left at the off - fought for its head - settled near the back - pushed along with 2f left before fading tamely
Tracked pace-setter close up on far rail with one rival for company - pushed into command inside final furlong - stayed on well to score
Settled off the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - finished hard to snatch second near the line
Disputed pace in middle stretch - pushed to front two out - overtaken approaching final furlong - stayed on through the finish - edged out of second late
Settled midfield out wide - pushed along hard 2f out - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Settled midfield early carrying plenty of enthusiasm - pressed for effort with 2f left - kept going without finding extra to finish fifth
Settled up with the pace out wide - shared the front spot - lost command 2f out - dropped away rapidly inside the final furlong
Hampered start - held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left then faded inside final furlong
Settled towards the back from the off - unable to land a blow throughout - finished well beaten in 8th
Dropped away early - trailed at the back throughout - never a factor and beaten a long way home
Led from the start - fenced cleanly throughout - driven out after the last - powered clear on the run-in to score unopposed
Settled midfield early - moved into contention before the second last marker point - up behind the front-runner four out - driven out in the closing stages and stayed on without threatening to win
Held up towards the back - moved into third clearing the last and driven out - unable to land a blow on the leading pair up the run-in - finished third
Sat behind front pack early - dropped back before 7th and needed urging after the following fence - faded from 2 out to finish 4th
Sat close up in second early - blundered four out and slipped back - errors two out and at the last saw effort fade to finish fifth
Sat close up early - hit the front over 3f out and opened a big gap inside the final furlong - stayed on unchallenged to score

Held up towards the back - pushed to keep tempo 6f out - made progress 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out - drifted right over a furlong out - into second inside the last but unable to threaten winner
Held up towards the back - off the pace and toiling with 3f left - rallied from the final furlong - moved into third close home but no threat to the winner

Sluggish start - settled towards back - made ground into contention over 3f out - squeezed for space over 2f out - moved into second but couldn't trouble winner - dropped back inside final furlong to finish fourth
Raced close to the pace early - drifted right under pressure from over 3f out - edged right again inside the last furlong - lost momentum close home to finish fifth
Close up early - hit front approaching 3f out - lost position inside final furlong - well held at finish
Handy early behind pace - made ground into contention 3f out - lost place approaching 2f out - well held at finish
Went straight to front early - lost command approaching 3f out - dropped away over 2f out - well held at the finish
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - still detached with over 3f to run - well held at the finish
Up with the front group - moved to the front 2f out - asserted under pressure inside the final furlong to win

Settled midpack - into 5th approaching 2f out - shaken up to move into second with a furlong and a half left - couldn't threaten leader inside final furlong and held on for the same effort to the line
Sat just behind the front group - 6th at halfway - asked for effort 2f out and moved into 3rd inside the final furlong - unable to close thereafter finishing 3rd
Sent clear early and set the tempo - pushed along and lost the advantage 2f out then in 4th with a furlong left unable to close - stayed on steadily to finish fourth
Held up at the back of the pack - driven into contention approaching 2f out - 6th and asked for more with a furlong left - stayed on at same rate to finish 5th
Hesitant start settling near the back - driven up into contention approaching the final two furlongs - 9th with a furlong left - stayed on late but always held
Sat behind the front group - 5th with 3f left - driven and dropped away soon after - unable to close from the final furlong finishing 7th
Held a midfield position early - asked for effort with over 2f left but unable to close - stayed on at same rate to finish 8th
Sat close to pace early - 2nd at halfway - dropped to 3rd and driven over 2f out - unable to close and faded from a furlong out to finish 9th
Settled in the pack early - driven with over two furlongs left but failed to threaten leaders inside the final furlong - stayed on at one gear to finish tenth
Held up towards the back - pushed along but made no headway 2f out - stayed on at same rate to finish 11th beaten well over 13 lengths
Sat close to pace early - 4th with 3f left - urged into effort over 2f out - dropped to 7th under pressure inside final furlong and could not find more
Hesitant start settling near the back - shifted left and driven up approaching 2f out but unable to threaten leaders - stayed on at one speed to finish 13th
Settled in the pack - driven approaching final furlong with little response - held no chance close home - well beaten in 14th
Held up in the pack - pushed along with no headway 2f out - unable to quicken through to the line - well held in 15th
Held up early - shown no threat and driven with two furlongs left - unable to close and finished 16th
Held up towards the back - urged forward but made no headway approaching final furlongs - unable to find more and finished well beaten
Settled close to the front - pushed along to hit the front a furlong out - kept up the drive under pressure inside the final furlong - fought off a late attempt to get on top and prevailed
Hampered start and hesitant to find rhythm - settled mid-pack - pushed through inner in final furlong - rallied hard to line but denied by a short head

Sent clear in front - pressed for effort with over two furlongs to run - lost the advantage approaching the final furlong but battled gamely - stayed on at an unchanged tempo but faded near the line to finish third
Handy early - roused to press the front with a furlong left - kept going at one gait then flattened out to finish fourth
Settled towards the back of the pack early - unable to land a blow in the finish - came home fifth
Hesitant start - held up towards the back for the duration - never landed a threat - finished sixth
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away soon after and beaten well by the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished eighth
Drifted left at the off - travelled strongly on the bridle - tracked the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - boxed in briefly with a furlong to run - responded to get up close home
Pulled hard early - settled mid-pack - made effortless progress 2f out - asked for effort and went in front - drifted right in final furlong and stayed on at one speed before being caught close home
Bumped at the start - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - closed on the front group approaching final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish third
Drifted left at the off - travelled with plenty of enthusiasm up front - pressed on in command - pushed along 2f out - overtaken inside final furlong - lost place close home
Bumped at the start - pulling hard early - settled in the pack - pushed along 2f out - stayed on final furlong - beaten into 5th
Pulled hard early - settled midpack - dropped away under pressure 2f out - stayed on late to finish sixth
Stumbled at the off - travelled with plenty of enthusiasm behind the front-runner - pressed for effort and dropped back 2f out - soon well held
Held up rear from the off - never involved - finished well held in 8th

Held up in the pack - made progress from 4 out and moved into fourth at the 3 out - pressing the head of affairs before the last - forged ahead 1f into the run-in under pressure - stayed on well to win
Set the pace early - came under pressure approaching 4th - driven out after the second-last and lost command a furlong from home - held no more in reserve to the line
Held up in the back markers - made ground into contention 4 out - fighting for fourth 2 out - driven out and stayed on - unable to land the frame for the win but held third
Tracked the front group - moved up to second approaching 2 out - still in contention after 2 out before dropping away on the run-in - one paced to finish 4th
Held up at the back - made progress 3 out - driven approaching last and stayed on same gear to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - nudged for effort 3 out - unable to find any advance - well held in 6th
Held up in midfield early - moved into 4th - driven approaching 3 out and dropped away - finished 7th well beaten
Held up handy wide - shared front spot before 4th - driven and faded after 2 out - eventually well held
Settled behind the pace early - slipped to midfield by the 3rd - under pressure and losing touch 3 out - well held at the finish
Settled midfield early - dropped away and driven approaching 3 out - well beaten from there - finished last of the field
Settled close up early - lost touch approaching 4th - eased and pulled up before 2 out
Set the pace from the start - pushed along a furlong out then edged away inside the final furlong - won with plenty in hand
Settled towards the back - forced to wait for room under 2f out - shifted right and finished second
Handy in the pack early - driven approaching 3f out - edged out of second inside final furlong and unable to quicken for third
Settled midpack early - shadowed leaders wide from the 2f mark and pushed along with over two furlongs left - lost momentum close home to finish fourth
Sat close to the front - driven approaching 3f out and drifted left over 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong
Settled last from the off - never involved - well held throughout - finished sixth
Settled just off the pace early - faded through the field 6f out and drifted right approaching 2f out - dropped away toward the finish
Settled midfield early - drifted markedly right with 4f left - dropped away from 2f out to finish well beaten
Settled in the pack early and 5th at halfway - improved into 3rd with urging 2f out then moved through to hit the front 150 yards out - drew clear to score comfortably
Set the pace - clear by two lengths approaching 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong then overtaken 150 yards from home and unable to fight back
Settled in the pack early - still 7th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left and up to 4th with a furlong to run - finished strongly to take 3rd
Held up early towards the back - urged into contention entering the straight and up to 5th inside the final furlong - stayed on same gait to finish 4th
Sat close to pace early - disputed second at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out but made no headway in third - held no more inside final furlong finishing fifth
Held up towards back of the pack - urged into effort in early straight - 9th two out - improved to 7th inside final furlong - stayed on same tempo to finish sixth
Sluggish start settling near the back - pushed along with two out and improved into 9th inside the final furlong - stayed on at one gear finishing well held
Sat close to the front group early - 4th at halfway - asked for effort 2f out but made no gain in 6th with a furlong left - held to line finishing 8th
Settled midpack - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - unable to close and stayed on same tempo to the line - finished ninth
Held up early - urged forward in the straight - stayed on same gear inside final 2f - always outpaced - finished 10th
Sat close to the front group - third at halfway - eased back to fifth under pressure two out and found nothing more late
Held up in the pack throughout - failed to make an impression - no response in the closing stages - finished well beaten in 12th
Up with the front group - 6th at halfway - laboured without response from 2f out and faded to finish 13th
Held up towards the back of the pack - driven and dropping away with 2f left - found nothing more and allowed to drop away inside the final furlong well beaten
Handy early - forged in front approaching 4f out - pushed along inside final furlong - edged left but stayed on strongly to the line - won comfortably
Settled close to the pace - pushed along over 2f out - closed on the front-runner inside the final furlong - stayed on to the line but unable to reel in the winner - beaten 1½ lengths into 2nd
Held up in the pack - pushed along over 2f out - found extra approaching the furlong pole and kept on - held for a place late
Set the pace early - overtaken 4f out but stayed involved - pressed for effort 2f out - battled on into final furlong - faded late to finish fourth

Held up mid-pack under restraint - pushed along with 2f left - nudged forward approaching final furlong - held level through the closing stages before fading late - dropped a place near the line to finish fifth
